metadata.order: forward on odd rounds, reversed on even rounds

sessions.early-screen: 2 rounds of 100 renders, V8 shared only; screening, not acceptance
sessions.four-quick-rounds: 4 rounds of 100 renders, V8 shared and Bun both bundles
sessions.final-confirmation: 3 rounds of 500 renders, fresh production assets and captures, timer/week/month/year, baseline and Duration

metadata.comparison: Compare only within each session; final session inputs recaptured after production client rebuild.

candidates.duration: Replace Show and For with a reactive conditional and array map; retain exact unit spans.
candidates.classes: Join timesheet-cell, current bucket background, caller class, and empty-cell text shade; both Cell callers inspected, only caller class font-medium.
candidates.cache: Cache complete svg node by icon.node WeakMap and scalar signature (bounded 64 entries/node); fall back for attributes or attributeNames; guard complete compiled Icon SHA-256, keep line count, equivalence and deep-frozen actual Icon-render tests.
